known_before_freeze: Selected wrap_writer.go bytes were previously acquired at both revisions and match. That alone does not prove all relevant documentation dependencies unchanged.
hypothesis: A complete selected-topic maintenance assessment can distinguish historical-note validity from updating its source pin to available local HEAD, while checking repository changes/callers/module/test scope rather than inferring NO-OP from one identical file.
audience: Maintainer deciding whether the existing bounded writer chapter applies to the selected new revision.
document_scope: Retain full existing wrapper/factory/interface/WriteHeader/Write/ReadFrom/capability/example/test/FAQ scope; add exact revision-impact/provenance decision. Not every Chi runtime behavior.
required_evidence: Both commit metadata and available relationship evidence; do not assert ancestry/order if unavailable.
Complete changed-path list and selected diff at both Git trees, no fetch.
Pinned wrap_writer.go and its tests, go.mod, license.
Repository-wide lexical NewWrapResponseWriter callers at both revisions, then inspect relevant changed caller contexts.
All existing chapter source-dependent meanings, code identifiers, EN/PT and citation ranges.
Separate historical contract and requested current-pin contract.
Human-reviewable isolated candidate diff, no external/original doc edits.
Actual syntax receipt binding if example code unchanged; static is not runtime.
Independent source procedure and negative source/provenance challenges, same-agent limits.

lifecycle_views.rule: NO-OP if exact historical source note remains correct; new HEAD alone does not falsify its declared historical revision.

MODIFY provenance if target is explicitly new revision and all selected meanings/dependencies remain supported. If relevant behavior/lineage changes, revise affected claims or INCONCLUSIVE, never assume unchanged file proves full scope.

population: One real revision pair with two correlated documentation-contract views, not two independent model samples.
criteria: documentation-done-v3.json plus full original chapter requirements, not posthoc scope reduction.
